about: Single source of truth for every art file. The game loads the first of public/<roots.licensed>/<path>, public/<roots.cc0>/<path>, public/<roots.placeholder>/<path> that exists with the right size. `kit` says where the file comes from in the CraftPix kit (npm run assets:import). Edit this file, then run `npm run assets:placeholders && npm run assets:docs`.

craftpix-cat-defense.name: CraftPix: Free Cartoon Cat Defense Game Asset Kit
craftpix-cat-defense.licence: craftpix.net Freebies licence: free for commercial and personal projects; the raw files must NOT be redistributed, and the files may not be used to train AI. Keep them in public/assets/licensed/ (gitignored).
